verdict.rationale: The public docs cover the full pre-recorded flow. The SDK "uploads, submits, and polls for you in a single call", and a synchronous HTTP endpoint returns transcripts for audio up to 20 minutes with no polling or webhooks. Probes confirm a machine-readable OpenAPI spec and llms.txt are live, and agent-specific instruction files are published, so an agent with a key can plausibly complete the job without a human. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of the API-key authentication scheme in the docs, and a hands-on or independent report of an agent completing submission-to-transcript end to end.
